articles.title: ‘Funds Scarce For Schools, Health Centres, But ₹4.69 Crore For Flyover Upkeep’: MP High Court Pulls Up Govt
articles.description: The Madhya Pradesh High Court questioned the state government over a fresh ₹4.69 crore tender for maintaining Bhopal’s Habibganj flyover when the existing contractor was obligated to rectify defects. The court contrasted the expenditure with resource constraints cited for schools, health centres and court complexes, and stayed both the tender process and contractor’s blacklisting.
